name: Preview newsletter
description: Call this when you need to generate a preview of a specific newsletter (optionally for a given A/B version and language) before publishing or sending. Use the send test email action instead if you want to deliver the content to an actual email address.
preconditions: The newsletter with the given ID must already exist.

id.description: The unique identifier of the newsletter to preview.

abVersion.description: The A/B test version to preview. Null for the default version.

language.description: Language code for the preview content (e.g., "en", "fr").

outputs.description: An object containing the generated preview data, such as HTML content or a preview URL.

side_effects: A preview of the newsletter is generated and returned.
